assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production UI bitmap, a SIMPLE compact inventory card slot for a Chinese folklore underworld mobile card game. Primary request: a single empty portrait 4:5 parchment inventory tile, deliberately much simpler and shorter than an ornate battle playing card. A warm ivory opaque paper surface with very subtle watercolor paper grain, an elegant thin antique gold and dark olive ink outline, softly worn organic corners with just tiny Chinese cloud hooks. Authentic delicate hand-painted gouache and ink, storybook Chinese ghost-market art. Flat front view, absolutely straight-on, no perspective. The tile occupies 96% of the 4:5 portrait canvas and is fully visible; actual transparent alpha outside its softly irregular paper silhouette. The ENTIRE interior is fully opaque warm cream, with quiet blank negative space for icon and labels that will be composed in code. No art window, no title ribbon, no inset panels, no dividing lines, no rolled scroll rods, no hanging cords, no large ornament. NO text, no letters, no numbers, no cost symbol, no icons, no characters, no illustrated scene, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no checkerboard pattern. This is a clean compact backpack-slot asset, not a screenshot or a complete UI mockup. Portrait aspect ratio 4:5, thin frame, very restrained ornament, readable at 80 pixels wide.
